name: Dialog
description: Base UI modal for short forms, editing and general information, with composable parts and a controlled shorthand interface.

figma.notes: No standalone Figma binding is assigned yet.

open.description: Required in shorthand mode. Controlled visibility. Closed dialogs unmount their content.

defaultOpen.description: Initial uncontrolled visibility for a composed Dialog.

onOpenChange.description: Receives the next visibility and Base UI event details in composition mode.

onOpenChangeComplete.description: Reports completion of opening or closing in composition mode.

showCloseButton.description: Defaults to true on DialogContent and default shorthand, false on DialogFooter.

title.description: Required in shorthand mode. Visible heading and accessible dialog name.

closeLabel.description: Localized accessible label for the default variant's close action.

onClose.description: Shorthand request to close; the consumer must set open to false.

initialFocus.description: Override the initial focus target, such as a search input.

finalFocus.description: Override the focus target after dismissal.

role.description: Use alertdialog only for critical prompts that need immediate announcement.

variant.description: Confirmation centers its title and relies on explicit footer actions instead of a close button.

footer.description: Caller-owned actions outside the scrolling content.

focus.note: Uses Button focus rings, confines Tab navigation, and restores the opener on close.

tapTarget.note: The visual close control fits the 24px icon with a 4px radius and Button's 44px hit-area extender.

accessibility.ariaPattern: Base UI modal dialog labelled by its visible h2; legacy alertdialog semantics remain available.
accessibility.interaction: Base UI handles modal isolation, focus trapping, Escape, outside presses, scroll locking and focus restoration. Default dialogs focus Close; confirmation dialogs focus the first control.

testing.rationale: Showcase and browser tests cover focus containment and restoration, controlled closing, outside dismissal, nested modals and responsive layout.
